_about: The Kitty merchant dictionary, Australia first. Patterns are regular expressions over Engine.normalise(raw_text): uppercase, card suffixes, store numbers, dates, amounts, state and capital-city tokens, PTY LTD and AU stripped, punctuation to spaces. Order inside the file does not matter: the longest matching pattern wins, a sheet Rules row always wins over the dictionary. hue is the brand's colour as a hex; the page tints a disc with it and draws two letters on top; a real logo only ever comes from a household's own gitignored logos/ pack. kind: merchant | transfer | fee | income | government. category_id names a row on the sheet's Categories tab.
